title: selfcheck's orphans check fails a distill run that holds a stale distill lock past LOCK_STALE_S
goal: bl_procs.lock_holders counts a lock's pid only while the lock is younger than ql_base.LOCK_STALE_S, so a run stuck while it holds a stale lock is an orphan

run:
import sys, os, json, time, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_procs as P, ql_base as Q
def holders(age):
    base = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    d = os.path.join(base, *P.HOOK_LOG)
    os.makedirs(d)
    p = os.path.join(d, Q.LOCK_NAME)
    t = time.time() - age
    json.dump(dict(pid=4242, started='x', started_epoch=t), open(p, 'w'))
    os.utime(p, (t, t))
    return P.lock_holders([base])
assert holders(10) == {4242}, 'a fresh lock holder is counted'
assert holders(Q.LOCK_STALE_S + 600) == set(), 'a stale lock holder is counted'
